providers.name: Santa Maria Water Sports
providers.tagline: Private wakeboard & wakesurf boat charter in Malta
providers.description: Santa Maria Water Sports runs private boat charters from the Valletta Waterfront aboard a Nautique G25 — one of the world's finest performance wake boats. Whether you want to learn wakeboard, ride wakesurf, fly on a wakefoil, or simply cruise Malta's dramatic coastline, their certified instructors tailor every session to your level. Charters run from 1 hour to a full day and can reach any point along Malta's coast from the Grand Harbour.

discount.label: 10% off any charter booking
discount.instructions: Online: enter the code in the 'Add Coupon or Promotional Code' field before paying. By phone: mention the code when booking. Valid throughout 2026.

highlights: Nautique G25 Centennial Edition (2025)
Wakeboard, wakesurf, wakefoil & tube
Certified instructors on every charter
1 hour to full-day charters
Beginner-friendly — from age 6 and up

experiences.title: Wakeboarding in Malta
experiences.tagline: Carve the wake behind a Nautique G25 — from your very first try
experiences.description: Strap in and learn to ride behind one of the world's finest wake boats. A certified instructor is in the boat for the whole session, so complete beginners (from age 6) get up on the board fast while experienced riders work on tricks. Private charter from the Valletta waterfront — you pick the calm-water spot.

experiences.title: Wakesurfing in Malta
experiences.tagline: Surf the boat's endless wave — no rope, just the wake
experiences.description: Once you're up, drop the rope and surf the clean wave the Nautique G25 throws — the most addictive, low-impact ride in wake sports. Beginner-friendly with instruction included, and gentle enough to keep going wave after wave along Malta's sheltered coast.

experiences.title: Wakefoiling in Malta
experiences.tagline: Fly silently above the water on a hydrofoil
experiences.description: The next step for confident riders — a hydrofoil board that lifts clear of the surface so you glide in near silence on the longest, smoothest ride of all. Coached one-to-one on a private charter from Valletta's Grand Harbour.

experiences.title: Adrenaline Tube Ride
experiences.tagline: Hold on tight — the high-energy ride for all ages
experiences.description: The pure-fun option: hang on to the towable tube as the boat carves and bounces across the bay. No skill needed, great for families and groups, and easily added to any charter alongside the wake sessions.

providers.name: Block Hotel
providers.tagline: 3-star hotel in the heart of Xlendi Bay, Gozo
providers.description: Block Hotel is a 3-star hotel in the heart of Xlendi Bay, Gozo — rooms, apartments and one Penthouse, right where the action is. This is a lively hotel. Guests come for the diving, stay for the rooftop, and end up at the bar. Xlendi Bay is on your doorstep — the Inland Sea, Fungus Rock and Dwejra are minutes away, and some of Europe's best dive sites are right below the building.

discount.label: 15% off Superior Rooms (Front & Rear) — Jun–Oct 2026
discount.instructions: Book directly via blockgozo.com using code JohnBlock26 at checkout, by phone or WhatsApp on +356 79343081, or by email at hello@blockgozo.com. Valid for Superior Rooms (Front & Rear) only, for stays between June and October 2026. Applies to the Flex BB rate — the rate becomes non-refundable once the discount is applied. Adults Only rooms. Cannot be combined with other offers.

highlights: 3-star hotel on Xlendi Bay, Gozo
Ritual Dive — one of Gozo's largest dive centers, in the building
ABOVE rooftop pool & bar on Level 5
FRONT Bar with live music, DJs, karaoke & sport screenings
Superior Rooms: adults only, private terrace & breakfast included

experiences.title: Stay on Xlendi Bay
experiences.tagline: Sleep where the action is — bay, rooftop pool & dive centre in one building
experiences.description: Base yourself right on Xlendi Bay in a lively 3-star hotel with rooms, apartments and a penthouse. Days start at the ABOVE rooftop pool, end at the FRONT bar, and the Inland Sea, Fungus Rock and Dwejra are minutes away. 15% off Superior Rooms (Front & Rear) for stays Jun–Oct 2026.

experiences.title: Dive Gozo with Ritual Dive
experiences.tagline: Some of Europe's best dive sites, straight from the building
experiences.description: Ritual Dive — one of Gozo's largest dive centres — operates inside the hotel, putting world-class sites like the Blue Hole and Xlendi reef on your doorstep. Try-dives for beginners through to technical and cave diving for the experienced, with gear and guiding sorted on site.

providers.name: Yippee Malta
providers.tagline: Multi-award-winning Gozo & Comino day tours by Tuk-Tuk, Jeep, Quad, Buggy & boat
providers.description:
Gozo's #1 rated, multi-award-winning tour operator for day trips across Gozo and Comino.

Choose your tour:

  • 🛺 Tuk-Tuk — chauffeured island sightseeing
  • 🚙 Jeep — chauffeured off-road adventure
  • 🏍 Quad Bike — self-drive, explore at your pace
  • 🚗 Buggy — self-drive, automatic
  • ⛵ Comino boat — Blue Lagoon, Crystal Lagoon & sea caves

Every full-day trip includes (~7 hrs):

  • ✓ Hotel pickup & drop-off from Malta or Gozo
  • ✓ Ferry crossing both ways
  • ✓ Multilingual guide (8+ languages)
  • ✓ Traditional Gozitan lunch or picnic
  • ✓ Comino swim stop (summer)

Sunset tours & Blue Lagoon cruises available mid-April to mid-October.

discount.instructions: Online: enter code JOHNYIP26 in the coupon / promotional code field at checkout on yippeemalta.com before paying. By phone or WhatsApp (+356 9967 0100): mention the code when booking.

highlights: Gozo's #1 multi-award-winning tour operator since 2018
Tuk-Tuk, Jeep, Quad Bike, Buggy & boat tours of Gozo and Comino

experiences.title: Self-drive Buggy Tour — Gozo & Comino
experiences.tagline: Take the wheel of your own off-road buggy across two islands
experiences.description:
Buckle up and steer your own all-terrain buggy through Gozo's epic scenery on a multi-award-winning adventure. You'll power off-road to the island's secret, off-beat and adored places, following an expert driver who leads a small, fun convoy — ideal for couples, families and friends chasing free-spirited fun.

Your day actually starts on the water: a boat trip along Comino's azure coastline takes in the famous Blue Lagoon, Crystal Lagoon and dramatic caves, with a refreshing swim stop (June–October) before the full-throttle buggy fun begins in Gozo.

~7 hours (excl. transfers) · all-inclusive · all year round.

  • €115 driver only · €195 driver + passenger
  • Drivers must be 21+, fully licensed — provisional licences not accepted
  • Includes: hotel pickup & drop-off, boat crossing to Gozo, light picnic lunch, English/French-speaking tour leader, helmets, raincoats, fuel & insurance

Stops include: Ta' Ċenċ Cliffs, Xlendi, Dwejra (Fungus Rock, Inland Sea & Watch Tower), Ta' Pinu, Wied il-Għasri, Xwejni Salt Pans, Marsalforn, Blue Lagoon & Comino's caves. Also available as a seasonal Sunset Tour (mid-April–mid-October, boat sails 2 PM, packed dinner by the sea at golden hour).

experiences.title: Self-drive Quad Bike Tour — Gozo & Comino
experiences.tagline: Ride your own 570cc quad through Gozo's wild backroads
experiences.description:
Driving in convoy behind a skilled tour leader, power through rugged valleys and backroads on a punchy 570cc quad bike. You'll visit Gozo's sleepy villages, wild countryside and epic coast — Yippee's multi-award-winning tours unlock secluded spots and neighbourhoods only the locals know.

The day opens with a boat trip to Comino: swim and snorkel the Blue Lagoon and Crystal Lagoon and slip into hidden caves (swim stop June–October) before the quad adventure across Gozo.

~7 hours (excl. transfers) · all-inclusive · all year round.

  • €115 driver only · €195 driver + passenger
  • Drivers must be 21+, fully licensed — provisional licences not accepted
  • Includes: hotel pickup & drop-off, boat crossing to Gozo, light picnic lunch, English/French-speaking tour leader, helmets, raincoats, fuel & insurance

Stops include: Ta' Ċenċ Cliffs, Xlendi, Dwejra, Ta' Pinu, Wied il-Għasri, Xwejni Salt Pans, Marsalforn, Blue Lagoon & Comino's caves. Also available as a seasonal Sunset Tour (mid-April–mid-October).

experiences.title: Chauffeured Tuk-Tuk Tour — Gozo & Comino
experiences.tagline: Sit back in an open tuk-tuk and fall in love with Gozo
experiences.description:
Come on a tuk-tuk journey of discovery and fall for Gozo's charms. Your multilingual chauffeur takes you to sights not easily reached by public transport, with unique access to lesser-known places cherished by locals. Open-air, breezy and relaxed — perfect for couples and families. Each tuk-tuk carries up to 6 people.

The day includes a mini Comino boat cruise & cave tour, taking in the Blue Lagoon and Crystal Lagoon with a swim stop in summer (June–October), plus a light traditional Gozitan lunch.

~7 hours (excl. transfers) · all-inclusive · all year round.

  • €85 adult · €60 child (3–12) · infants free (0–2)
  • Includes: hotel pickup & drop-off, boat crossing to Gozo, traditional Gozitan lunch, multilingual chauffeur (English, French, German, Italian, Polish, Dutch, Arabic, Spanish)

Stops include: Sanap Cliffs, Xlendi, Knight's Washhouses (Fontana), the Citadel (Victoria), Dwejra, Xwejni Salt Pans, Marsalforn, Blue Lagoon & Comino's caves. Ġgantija Temples or Calypso viewpoint optional (skip-the-line €10). Also runs as a seasonal Sunset Tour. Private tours from €240/vehicle.

experiences.title: Chauffeured Jeep Safari — Gozo & Comino
experiences.tagline: Big-wheel epic adventure across Gozo's kaleidoscope of colour
experiences.description:
Big wheels steer epic encounters. The all-action Jeep is built for fun-lovers who like it big and bold — power through lush green valleys along the sparkling coast and see Gozo's kaleidoscope of colours. Comfy, cool and capable, the chauffeured Jeeps seat 5 forward-facing guests and suit any terrain. Grab your friends, family or work crew and let's explore!

The day includes a mini Comino boat cruise & cave tour — Blue Lagoon, Crystal Lagoon and a summer swim stop (June–October) — plus a light traditional Gozitan lunch.

~7 hours (excl. transfers) · all-inclusive · all year round.

  • €85 adult · €60 child (3–12) · infants free (0–2)
  • Includes: hotel pickup & drop-off, boat crossing to Gozo, traditional Gozitan lunch, multilingual chauffeur (8+ languages)

Stops include: Sanap Cliffs, Xlendi, Knight's Washhouses, the Citadel, Dwejra, Ta' Pinu, Xwejni Salt Pans, Marsalforn, Blue Lagoon & Comino's caves. Also runs as a seasonal Sunset Tour. Private Jeep tours from €240/vehicle.

experiences.title: Blue Lagoon & Comino Boat Cruise
experiences.tagline: Half-day swim, snorkel & sightsee around the Blue Lagoon
experiences.description:
Pure coastal bliss: swim, snorkel and sightsee as you immerse yourself in the beauty of Comino and its world-famous Blue Lagoon. Let the scenery soothe you as the skilled captain sails past lesser-known secret bays and you get up close — even floating inside the island's dramatic caves and epic coastal sites.

A 3.5-hour half-day tour running twice daily — a morning departure and a sunset cruise for golden-hour magic. Every adult gets a complimentary glass of wine and unlimited cold water; snacks, drinks and snorkelling gear are available on board.

  • €25 per person · start times 10:30 AM & 5:30 PM · seasonal mid-April–mid-October
  • Includes: free use of snorkelling equipment, free-flowing water, welcome glass of wine, audio guidance at each stop
  • Optional 2-way transfers €10 p.p. · cave tour subject to availability (charged separately)

Stops include: Elephant's Head cave, Santa Maria Bay & Cave, Blue Lagoon & Crystal Lagoon. Departs Marfa or Ċirkewwa Café (Malta).

experiences.title: Round Gozo & Comino Cruise
experiences.tagline: Full-day boat trip right around two islands
experiences.description:
An unforgettable 6-hour boat trip all the way around the islands of Gozo and Comino — breathtaking coastlines, crystal-clear waters and some of the most stunning bays in the Maltese islands. You'll visit hard-to-reach bays with several hidden gems along the way, and of course the famous azure Blue Lagoon.

On board you'll enjoy a traditional Maltese ftira lunch with a refreshing drink and dessert, served as you relax and take in the views. Small group sizes give you maximum comfort. This is a highly popular tour that sells out quickly.

  • €65 adult · €35 child (3–12) · infants free (0–2)
  • Start time 9:30 AM · seasonal mid-April–mid-October
  • Includes: transfers to/from designated Malta & Gozo locations, packed Maltese ftira lunch (drink, water & dessert), use of snorkelling equipment
  • Optional cave tour on a smaller boat €10 p.p. (subject to availability, charged separately)

Swim stops & sights: Crystal Lagoon, Xlendi, Dwejra, Marsalforn, Ramla, San Blas, Daħlet Qorrot, Ħalfa Rock, Elephant's Head, Santa Maria Bay & Cave and the Blue Lagoon.

providers.name: Gozo Kayak Tours
providers.tagline: Guided sea-cave kayak tours from Xlendi Bay, Gozo
providers.description:
Gozo Kayak Tours runs small-group guided kayak adventures from Xlendi Bay, based on the waterfront opposite The Boathouse Restaurant. Paddle Gozo's dramatic south coast to sea caves and hidden corners only reachable by water, through crystal-clear turquoise seas — with two swim stops inside the caves and plenty of time for photos.

Every tour is guided from start to finish: think sea caves, coastal adventures and calm, clear water. Great for beginners, couples, families and groups, with all the gear included — life jackets, snorkelling masks and dry bags, plus a small locker on land. Booking is quick and easy over WhatsApp.
highlights: Guided kayak tours from Xlendi Bay, Gozo
Sea caves only reachable by kayak
Crystal-clear turquoise waters & coastal adventures
Great for beginners, couples, families & groups
Two swim stops inside the caves
Life jackets, snorkel masks & dry bags provided

experiences.title: Sea Cave Kayak Tour
experiences.tagline: Paddle Xlendi's cliffs to hidden sea caves
experiences.description: A guided kayak tour along Gozo's dramatic south coast from Xlendi, paddling to sea caves you can only reach by water — including the huge L-Għar ta' Santa Katarina. Crystal-clear turquoise water the whole way, two swim stops inside the caves, and plenty of time for photos. Suitable for beginners, couples, families and groups — life jackets, snorkelling masks and dry bags are all provided. Book in seconds over WhatsApp.
